summary: Short kerb on a multi-lane arterial beside a shelter; nobody parks here.
reasons: Nowhere to pull out of traffic

drivers.seclusion: Open to the arterial and a wide path; nearest homes about 50 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb edge of a multi-lane road with a footpath and shelter beside it; no pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Heavy arterial traffic with a nearby signalised crossing.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along this kerb and no marked parking lane.
